title: Sibling sweep: align MemoryError/MockError to canonical non_exhaustive named-field shape in 5 extension-server crates
description:
**Pattern source**: bd:JMAP-826m.47 aligned jmap-metadata-server's MemoryError + MockError to mirror jmap-mail-server's canonical shape:
- #[non_exhaustive]
- Named-field struct { description: String }
- pub fn new(impl Into<String>) -> Self
- pub fn description(&self) -> &str

The pub tuple-struct shape with a pub String field forecloses adding structured fields (error kind, source reference, account id) without a breaking change — exactly what non_exhaustive + named-field is designed to enable.

**Canonical state**:
- jmap-mail-server (canonical): correct named-field shape at crate-jmap-mail-server/src/memory.rs (around line 475).
- jmap-tasks-server: named-field shape at crate-jmap-tasks-server/src/memory.rs (around line 89). Need to verify non_exhaustive presence.
- jmap-sharing-server: special shape at crate-jmap-sharing-server/src/memory.rs (around line 282). Need to verify alignment.
- jmap-metadata-server: aligned in JMAP-826m.47.

**Divergent siblings** (still 'pub struct ... (pub String);'):
- crate-jmap-calendars-server/src/memory.rs (MemoryError around line 80) and lib.rs (MockError around line 224)
- crate-jmap-chat-server/src/memory.rs (MemoryError around line 432)
- crate-jmap-contacts-server/src/memory.rs (MemoryError around line 77) and lib.rs (MockError around line 165)
- crate-jmap-filenode-server/src/memory.rs (MemoryError around line 69) and lib.rs (MockError around line 144)
- crate-jmap-tasks-server/src/lib.rs (MockError around line 186) — need to verify

**Fix shape** (cookie-cut from JMAP-826m.47):
1. Replace pub struct ErrName(pub String); with non_exhaustive named-field shape.
2. Add new(impl Into<String>) constructor.
3. Add description(&self) -> &str accessor.
4. Update Display impl to use self.description.
5. Find all construction sites (likely 5-15 per crate) and replace ErrName(...) with ErrName::new(...).
6. Find all pattern-match sites and replace ErrName(msg) with capture-and-call-description-method.

**Rationale**: Workspace AGENTS.md canonical-template propagation rule: siblings mirror the canonical. The pub String tuple shape locks in primitive obsession AND prevents future contributors from adding structured error context without a breaking change. The non_exhaustive named-field shape is the forward-compatible foundation.

**Sub-bead candidate**: file per-crate children .1-.5 if the sweep is paused mid-flight.
